model_selection.department_protocol: 3-fold stratified cross-validation; choose highest mean macro-F1; final evaluation on untouched 20% test set
model_selection.priority_protocol: 5-fold grouped (leak-free) CV on CivicFlow's labelled priority dataset selects the model family by macro-F1; headline numbers come from an untouched grouped 80/20 hold-out; deployed model is refit on all data.
model_selection.primary_metric: Macro F1 because both tasks are multiclass and class distributions are imbalanced.

critical_priority: Critical is a transparent emergency safety escalation layer because the source severity data contains only Low/Medium/High.
